justification: One user-facing message: a failed request read as 'no requirements'. Standard: one component, a boolean state.

pre_impl.existing_data: POST /api/sepp/structured-requirements, one call per detected SEPP
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If one SEPP call fails and another returns rows, rows show and the failure note does not
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Render-time only, applies to every page view

functions.name: loadStructuredRequirements
functions.input: propertyData constraints with detected SEPP ids
functions.output: requirement list plus the seppNotChecked flag in state
functions.if_none: returns early, no fetch, flag stays false

break_it.scenario: The requirements API returns HTTP 500 for the Housing SEPP
break_it.what_happens: Before: 'No Housing SEPP structured requirements'. Now: not checked

break_it.scenario: The fetch throws because the network is down
break_it.what_happens: The card now shows not checked

break_it.scenario: One SEPP call fails while another SEPP call returns rows
break_it.what_happens: Rows from the answered SEPP show; no note about the failed one
break_it.how: Out of scope: the reviewed bug was the empty-list case only

falsifiable_check.observed_red: Ran the new test on unfixed StateLevelControls.tsx: 2 failed, 1 passed; the answered-empty case passed, proving the render reaches the text.
